summary: The guide page adheres strictly to the assigned chapter brief, scope, and primary source materials. It addresses ongoing workflow review, disciplined evaluation of improvement requests without fabricated ROI, authorized FAQ guidance, and preparing scripted software demonstrations. All citations to the ISO/IAF APG papers and NIST RPD-G-07 are accurately quoted and properly contextualized. All illustrative examples are clearly designated as hypothetical scenarios based on an unnamed machining manufacturer, and no unverified software capabilities are asserted.
recordNames: Automatic report of repeat findings by process
decisions: Establish operational and design review rhythms with designated role ownership
Select and monitor a small set of workflow measures evaluated by process and role rather than plant-wide averages alone
Authorize or reject configuration changes through formal change control, testing sample findings prior to release
Decide which improvement requests to pursue based on plant measurements and failure evidence rather than unverified ROI claims
Assign improvement backlog statuses: do now, schedule, wait for more evidence, or decline
Determine legacy record migration scope: migrate open and recent closed findings, and place older records into an indexed archive
Assign decision permissions with backups and enforce separation of duties between action implementers and verifiers
Archive obsolete records with index entries instead of deleting historical quality records
Score software demonstrations live against pre-set acceptance criteria using scripted failure cases and anonymized plant data
